license: Original code and fixtures authored for this evaluation. No upstream source file is copied into this package. The behaviour contract comes from the documented Windows overlapped-I/O model: a request is identified by its OVERLAPPED structure, CancelIoEx cancels that one request and may be called from any thread, CancelIo only covers the calling thread's requests on the handle, and the terminal state is read back through GetOverlappedResult as ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED / ERROR_NOT_FOUND (MSDN: CancelIoEx, CancelIo, GetOverlappedResult).
lineage: Documented Windows overlapped-I/O semantics (per-request cancellation by OVERLAPPED, callable from any thread; ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED as the terminal state) -> workspace module wcancel frozen in the naive shape that cancels through the calling thread's batch entry point and reports every outcome as an ordinary I/O error -> Windows cancellation contract expressed as acceptance criteria A-G -> evaluator-side independent measurement: the grader creates its own named pipe opened for overlapped I/O, issues its own pending reads, cancels from a second thread and reads the kernel's terminal state, never trusting the candidate's return value -> local oracle/no-change differential calibration -> container control runs on the pinned Windows Server Core image.
pollution_risk: Low. The subject is per-request cancellation of Windows overlapped I/O through CancelIoEx plus GetOverlappedResult terminal-state reporting. A dedup sweep over all 159 records of the procurement Base for the keywords CancelIoEx, CancelIo, OVERLAPPED, 重叠 I/O, 异步 IO 取消, IOCP, 完成端口, 句柄继承, STARTUPINFOEX, 稀疏文件, VirtualQueryEx, PE/COFF, USN, 注册表变更通知 and SeCreateSymbolicLink returned no hit for the cancellation family; the occupied neighbouring families are sparse-file allocation (this batch's 215), virtual address space (216), handle inheritance (218), PE image checksums (219 predecessor), file identity and hard links, Job Objects, reparse points and reserved device names. Python's own asyncio/subprocess surface cannot express a per-request kernel cancellation, so a relabelled duplicate of an existing task is not possible.
authorization: No external repository is vendored. The only third-party artefacts are the pinned Microsoft Windows Server Core base image, the PSF-licensed Python 3.12.9 embeddable distribution, MinGit and the offline wheelhouse already used by the other tasks in this batch. No network access is required to build or grade the task.
